about.manifesto: I am early in my career, and that is my advantage. I learn fast, I work hard, and I see marketing the way my generation lives it: quick, visual, social and digital.
about.title: From the dish pit to the marketing desk.
paragraphs: I grew up in Venlo and started in a lunchroom kitchen, washing dishes. Within a year I was preparing hot and cold dishes. Since then I have worked in kitchens, restaurants and bars, mostly on weekends and in the holidays.
That taught me how to read people, stay calm when it gets busy and finish what I start. It is where my communication began.
Now I study Marketing & Communication at De Rooi Pannen and support the marketing and communication team at Bibliotheek Venlo with content, promotion and campaign work. Next, I want to learn abroad.
